newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-COPPELL APPOINTED PALACE MANAGER AGAIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-COPPELL APPOINTED PALACE MANAGER AGAIN.

text.p: Steve Coppell was named as Crystal Palace's caretaker manager on Friday following Dave Bassett's sudden departure to Nottingham Forest on Thursday.
Coppell, 41, who quit Manchester City after only 33 days in charge at Maine Road last November, will look after the team until the end of the season.
Ray Lewington, who was tipped to take over, remains as first team coach.
Coppell became the then-youngest manager in the league when he took control of Palace in June 1984 and stayed in the post until June 1993. He became Palace's Director of Football in June 1995.
Coppell left Palace for Manchester City last October. He cited stress as the reason for leaving City just five weeks later.

Palace are currently sixth in the first division and have a realistic chance of making the play-offs at the end of the season. Coppell's first match back in charge is Saturday's away league game at Oxford.
